name: tether_v005
hypothesis: An inflated A* planner plus a domain-randomized residual controller can execute destination commands through reachable clutter layouts while preserving tether clearance.
algorithm: SB3 PPO residual motor control with geometric route planner
notes: CPU fallback after v004 CUDA smoke coincided with WSL restart. Six randomized physical boxes, straight-path blocker, reachable layouts and bounded 2D A*. Ground-truth state/geometry, no vision. No arbitrary-obstacle guarantee. Final test seeds are separate from smoke probes and validation.
